P2: With `installShims = true` (default), the four shims are inert unless the matching package manager exists on PATH and the user actually runs the shim. Per socket.dev docs, `socket npm`/`socket npx` "call npm and npx" and resolve the real manager from PATH, and `socket-pnpm`/`socket-yarn` "require user-supplied tooling" — so in a devenv without `languages.javascript` (or without pnpm/yarn for those shims), every shim invocation fails; and even with the managers present, a plain `npm install` is not intercepted unless the user aliases `npm`→`socket-npm`. State these prerequisites in the option description (and/or pull in the managers when the option is enabled) so the default doesn't overpromise scanning-on-install.

          PATH, so the matching package manager must be available (e.g.
          languages.javascript.enable); they only gate installs when

P3: The pnpm/yarn shims are untested at runtime: the PR's version checks only cover `socket` and `socket-npm`, and the nix build only proves the wrapper files exist — it cannot prove `npx --yes --package 'socket@1.2.1' socket-pnpm` resolves, since npx only runs bins declared in the package's `bin` field. socket.dev docs confirm the `socket-npm`/`socket-npx` aliases, but not `socket-pnpm`/`socket-yarn` as published bins. Confirm all four names resolve against the pinned version (e.g. `npx --yes --package socket@1.2.1 socket-pnpm --version`) or drop/rename the unresolvable shims.
